trigger.description: The daemon commits a source memory, database audit row, and index job, then cannot append the audit JSONL stream or complete/encode the full remember report. The daemon retains the exact committed IDs and still attempts queued indexing.
setup_commands: # Initialize a fresh workspace database and make .ee/audit.jsonl a directory before its first remember.
trigger.invocation: ee.daemon.write with a supported memory payload addressed to that workspace

message_contains: Do not repeat the source write
